covariance: Equal TRAIN patient and equal within-patient class weights; mean of 0.5*(populationCovEZ+populationCovNEZ). Primary direction is direct mean difference. Secondary Fisher uses solve(Sigma+lambdaI,delta), lambda=max(0.1*trace(Sigma)/12,1e-12), then normalize. No outcome tuning.
T: Signed projected EZ-minus-NEZ separation / sqrt(0.5*(populationVarEZ+populationVarNEZ)+epsilon). epsilon=1e-8*max(v^T Sigma_TRAIN v,1e-12), fixed separately per TRAIN direction/arm.
